description_en: Reruns a workflow starting from a specified node of a work item
description_zh: 从工作项指定节点重跑
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo rerun-workflow-node --collaboration-group-id cg_9401 --plan-id plan_v3 --node-key query.amount --region cn-hangzhou
name: RerunWorkflowNode

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，缺省使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The current physical plan ID after the rerun. Rerunning a fixed planning node may generate a new plan. Use this value for subsequent queries
parameters.help_zh: 重跑后的当前物理计划ID；固定规划节点重跑可能生成新计划，后续查询应使用此值
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en: The key of the starting node for the rerun, which includes fixed planning nodes and business execution nodes
parameters.help_zh: 重跑起始节点 key，包含固定规划节点和业务执行节点
parameters.name: node_key

affectedNodeKeys.description_en: The list of node keys affected by this rerun, which the caller can use to refresh data. This list is always included in a successful response and may be omitted in an error response
affectedNodeKeys.description_zh: 本次重跑影响的节点 key 列表，供调用方刷新；成功响应恒包含，错误响应可缺省

items.description_en: The list of node keys affected by this rerun, which the caller can use to refresh data. This list is always included in a successful response and may be omitted in an error response
items.description_zh: 本次重跑影响的节点 key 列表，供调用方刷新；成功响应恒包含，错误响应可缺省

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

planId.description_en: The current physical plan ID after the rerun. Rerunning a fixed planning node may generate a new plan. Use this value for subsequent queries
planId.description_zh: 重跑后的当前物理计划ID；固定规划节点重跑可能生成新计划，后续查询应使用此值

revision.description_en: The current plan revision number after the rerun
revision.description_zh: 重跑后的当前计划修订号

runId.description_en: The current workflow run ID. This value remains unchanged when a fixed node generates a new revision
runId.description_zh: 当前工作流运行ID，固定节点生成新 revision 时保持不变

stateVersion.description_en: The workflow state version after the rerun is accepted
stateVersion.description_zh: 重跑被接受后的工作流状态版本
